learning_outcomes.text: Acquire technical and design skills related to the study, selection, and sizing of fluidic prime movers and operating machines.
Analysis of first and second principles of energy systems and their components.
Performance and plant schemes of steam power plants, gas and mixed gas-steam plants, internal combustion engines, nuclear, and renewable energy plants.

syllabus_topics: Efflux in rotary and stationary ducts of compressible and incompressible fluids
Axial, centrifugal, and reciprocating compressors and pumps
Recalls of thermodynamics and related principles
Fluid dynamics recalls, momentum and energy
Theory of similitude and dimensional analysis
Flow in nozzles and in rotor and stator cascades of turbomachines
Velocity triangles, work exchange between fluid and blade, degree of reaction, blade efficiency, notable degrees of reaction
Prime mover and operating turbomachines with compressible fluid: rotor and stator components of steam and gas turbines and of centrifugal and axial compressors, multistage solutions
Prime mover and operating turbomachines with incompressible fluid: Pelton, Francis and Kaplan hydraulic turbines, centrifugal and axial pumps
Machines inserted in a circuit, in series and in parallel
Volumetric compressors and expanders, reciprocating and rotary
Free-flow prime movers and operating machines: introduction to wind turbines and propellers
Thermodynamics recalls, first and second principle, Carnot effect, multiplicity of sources and Clausius
Exergy, calculation of exergetic efficiency with direct and inverse methods
Combined cycles: combined - STIG - HAT - RWI
Performance and components of 2-stroke and 4-stroke engines
Introduction to combustion and pollutant control
Application aspects of basic topics, numerical exercises, and/or guided visits to companies and plants for the additional 3 ECTS

assessment_methods.method: Written examination (2 numerical questions on plant and component sizing)
Oral examination (2 open questions on plants and/or components)

assessment_rules: The written examination has a minimum score of 15/30. The oral examination has a minimum score of 18/30.
bibliography: V. Dossena et al., Macchine a fluido, Città Studi Edizioni, 2° edizione, 2020
S. Stecco, G. Manfrida, "Impianti di conversione energetica", Pitagora
degree: Corso di laurea in Ingegneria meccanica (L-9)
